parent_objective: design fresh source-balanced temporal command-response wave after M722 source concentration audit

public_gates: design fixes M719 max_pairs early-seed saturation with source-balanced selection
design includes per-seed per-fault-family and source-role quotas
design preserves temporal action and outcome gates separately
design carries sentinel allocation into the wave rather than adding sentinels after the fact
design keeps actor input contract unchanged
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat M722 action-only rows as source-positive
do not add hidden fault labels or oracle values to actor observations
do not simply raise max_pairs without source balancing

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_source_coverage: design source-balanced temporal command-response data generation
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers a no-training temporal wave that avoids M719 early-seed saturation before another outcome boundary miner
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new source-positive or checkpoint-promotion claim
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot enforce seed and fault-family diversity
stop if sentinels cannot be sampled from the same wave
stop if temporal action and outcome gates are collapsed into one metric
stop actor mutation until a source-balanced outcome-positive corpus exists
fallback_plan: if source-balanced temporal rows remain action-only, design sequence-level interventions
if source-balanced rows are outcome-positive, audit before source export or objective design
if source-balanced generation is blocked by single-track fidelity, design four-wheel or explicit-yaw-disturbance dynamics
if compute cost is too high, stage the wave by source quotas and register the reduced scale
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M723 promotes to fresh_source_balanced_temporal_wave after source concentration audit

hypothesis: A fresh no-training temporal command-response wave with source-balanced pair selection can remove the M719/M722 seed-concentration bottleneck and produce a better basis for outcome boundary mining.
success_criteria: M724 defines source-balanced selection axes and quotas
M724 defines required M725 implementation artifacts
M724 keeps temporal action and outcome gates separate
M724 defines sentinel allocation and diversity thresholds
no training PPO actor update or promotion occurs
failure_criteria: design only increases max_pairs without source balancing
design treats action-only rows as outcome proof
decision_rule: M724 may admit only a no-training M725 source-balanced temporal wave implementation. It must not admit actor update, PPO, or promotion.
